chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-A'la ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The (legislated) shares do not exceed (their limits).

key_terms.السهام: The prescribed inheritance shares fixed in the Quran (4:11-12, 4:176)
key_terms.عول: The doctrine of 'awl: the Sunni practice of proportionally reducing all shares when they collectively exceed the estate; rejected in Shia jurisprudence

ai.seo_question: What is the Shia ruling on 'awl (proportional increase of inheritance shares) according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) states the foundational Shia jurisprudential position that the fixed inheritance shares (siham) prescribed in the Quran do not undergo 'awl — that is, they are not proportionally reduced when they nominally exceed the whole estate. This ruling directly contradicts the Sunni doctrine of 'awl which distributes shares proportionally when they exceed 100%. In Shia fiqh, the correct solution is to reduce only the shares of specific heirs (daughters) while keeping others intact, preserving the integrity of the divine allotments.
